answer_2.quote: We measure the answer change rate (∆ Rate) after adding the irrelevant context... we compute the pointwise mutual information (PMI) between context and context-based candidates...

answer_4.quote: We perform this annotation on a randomly sampled set of 500 context-based candidates across different subdatasets... annotators identify whether each answer incorporates identifiable features from the context and whether it belongs to the correct abstract class.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators check (i) if the answer integrates identifiable context features and (ii) if it matches the expected abstract class indicated by the query.
